title: 'Evil' Mom Cut Baby from Pregnant Daughter's Womb: Police
description:
Michigan police investigate the disappearance of 22-year-old Rebecca Park, who was 38 weeks pregnant when she vanished. Bodycam footage follows detectives as they question birth mother Cortney Bartholomew, stepfather Bradly Bartholomew, and other suspects in the disturbing case.
